Answer: C
Reason: Comparing Figure 1 and Figure 2 reveals that the initial extensive consolidation in the left lung has largely resolved, while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right upper lung zone. This pattern of clearing infiltrates in one area accompanied by new infiltrates in another is characteristic of migratory pulmonary opacities, a hallmark finding of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
